notes:
Inbound SMB. Fast-growing commerce analytics startup focused on improving search & post-purchase support for mid-market merchants. Primary contact: Jonah Park (CTO) - technical, cost-sensitive. Wants to start on Hosted API (public cloud) via self-serve; may upgrade to Dedicated if traffic doubles. Key theme: model selection tradeoffs (quality vs cost).

Call highlights: 
- Jonah: 'We need embeddings + a chat assistant that feels accurate but can't triple our infra cost.'
- Asked about Llama-2-13B vs Mistral-7B vs Qwen variants for product search embeddings and short-form chat. Interested in 8-bit / quantized server-side options to reduce cost.
- Latency target for chat: <=200ms 95p for small payloads; throughput target initially ~20 req/s with burst to 80. Embeddings workload: 100k vectors/month, prefer low-cost vector generator; willing to trade off a small drop in embedding quality for 2x cost savings.
- Security: SSO/SAML for admin console, audit logs, ability to set data retention TTL (30/90/365 days). No on-prem requirement today.

Sales notes / shorthand:
- "self-serve -> trial credits used"; wants configuration guidance for batching/kv cache.
- Ask: provide tokenized cost estimates (per-1M tokens) and embedding unit costs for Llama-2-13B (quantized), Mistral-7B, Qwen-7B.
- Wants sample prompt templates and recommended temperature/top_p for product-recommendation vs summarization tasks.

Attachments / refs: pricing deck link + security FAQ sent. Jira RED-1218 opened to answer embedding throughput question.
use_case_summary: Primary pilot: product search & support chat for SMB merchants. Pipeline: ingest catalogs -> embeddings store -> vector search -> chat layer that retrieves context and rewrites/answers. Priorities: keep response quality high for search relevance, minimize per-query embedding cost, and keep chat latency under 200ms p95.
